title: Nitpicky lens findings
description: Input contract: one JSON file per review source (a walkthrough agent, an axe-core import, your own script). One file per source; nitpicky merge consumes every *.json in <run-dir>/findings/.

lens.description: Review source name, e.g. consistency, friction, verbose-language, visual-polish, accessibility — or axe, lighthouse, your-tool.

coverage.description: Optional per-route coverage report; merge aggregates it across sources.

url.description: Page URL where the defect shows.

screenshot.description: Path relative to the run dir, conventionally screenshots/<lens>-<slug>.png. Missing files are allowed: the finding is kept but marked proof-broken in the portal.

suspected_env_cause.description: Set when the failure looks server-side, not an app defect.
